## Module to write
path: ServerScriptService/ForgeChecks.server.luau
purpose: Feature: Create executable checks (forge checks --plan) that run a live playtest and assert the telemetry counters: map_built=1, plaza_built=1, themes_built=6, plot_assigned (after claim or the 20s auto-claim), auto_claims, cubes_dropped rising about every 2s, cubes_collected rising, cashin_fx_sent>0, and Cash rising. Also assert that there are no output errors or warnings and that cubes_dropped stays 0 before a claim. Run them, then hand any failing check to the fixer. Keep existing counter names unchanged. -- Studio-only runner (returns immediately unless RunService:IsStudio()) that executes the plan from ForgeChecksPlan. It subscribes to LogService.MessageOut from the start and records Error and Warning entries, ignoring lines that start with its own '[ForgeCheck]' prefix. It waits for the first player and for map_built, plaza_built and themes_built, then snapshots telemetry through ForgeTelemetry.get/snapshot. During the pre-claim window it samples cubes_dropped and plot_assigned and records whether cubes_dropped stayed 0 before any claim. Claim phase: in 'auto' mode it waits for the 20s auto-claim and asserts plot_assigned and auto_claims rose. In 'gate' mode (Workspace attribute ForgeCheckMode='gate') it pivots the player's character onto the first unclaimed gate part to trigger the real Touched claim and asserts plots_claimed and plot_assigned rose. After the claim it samples cubes_dropped, cubes_collected and the player's leaderstats Cash every 2.5s for about 4 windows, then checks cashin_fx_sent>0 and the Output log. For each check it prints one line, '[ForgeCheck] PASS <id>' or '[ForgeCheck] FAIL <id> expected=<..> actual=<..>' (via print, never warn), then a final single line '[ForgeCheck] RESULT {json}' with {passed, failed, failures:[{id, expected, actual}]} that the CLI parses to hand each failing check to the fixer. It sets Workspace attribute ForgeChecksDone=true when finished. It only reads game state and never mutates cash, plots or existing counters. It bumps only its own counters 'checks_passed' and 'checks_failed' with ForgeTelemetry.count. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: checks_passed, checks_failed.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/ForgeChecksPlan.luau, ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau

```luau
-- ForgeChecksPlan: pure data describing the live playtest check plan.
-- No services, no side effects. A runner reads this table, samples the
-- ForgeTelemetry counters and asserts each check.

local Plan = {
	version = 1,

	-- Timing (seconds)
	timing = {
		settleSeconds = 3,        -- wait after startup before the first sample
		preClaimWindow = 8,       -- observe before any claim (shorter than 20s auto-claim)
		sampleInterval = 2.5,     -- sampling interval after claim
		maxRunSeconds = 50,       -- hard cap for the whole playtest
		autoClaimSeconds = 20,    -- game's auto-claim delay (reference only)
	},

	-- 'auto' waits for the 20s auto-claim; 'gate' walks the character onto a gate.
	claimMode = "auto",

	-- Counter names the runner bumps on the server through ForgeTelemetry.
	telemetry = {
		passed = "checks_passed",
		failed = "checks_failed",
	},

	-- Counters whose names are owned by the game (unchanged).
	counters = {
		"map_built",
		"plaza_built",
		"themes_built",
		"plot_assigned",
		"auto_claims",
		"cubes_dropped",
		"cubes_collected",
		"cashin_fx_sent",
	},

	-- Leaderstat read for cash_rising.
	cashStat = {
		folder = "leaderstats",
		name = "Cash",
	},

	-- Check entries: {id, kind, counter, expect, ...}
	checks = {
		{
			id = "map_built_eq_1",
			kind = "counter_eq",
			counter = "map_built",
			expect = 1,
			when = "after_settle",
		},
		{
			id = "plaza_built_eq_1",
			kind = "counter_eq",
			counter = "plaza_built",
			expect = 1,
			when = "after_settle",
		},
		{
			id = "themes_built_eq_6",
			kind = "counter_eq",
			counter = "themes_built",
			expect = 6,
			when = "after_settle",
		},
		{
			-- cubes_dropped must remain 0 while no plot is claimed
			id = "no_drops_before_claim",
			kind = "zero_before_claim",
			counter = "cubes_dropped",
			expect = 0,
			gateCounter = "plot_assigned",
			gateValue = 0,
			when = "pre_claim",
		},
		{
			id = "plot_assigned_gte_1",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "plot_assigned",
			expect = 1,
			when = "after_claim",
		},
		{
			id = "auto_claims_gte_1",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "auto_claims",
			expect = 1,
			onlyMode = "auto",
			when = "after_claim",
		},
		{
			-- cubes_dropped must grow by >= minDelta in every window after claim;
			-- a faster rate (Dropper 2 bought) is accepted.
			id = "cubes_dropped_rising",
			kind = "rising_windows",
			counter = "cubes_dropped",
			expect = {
				minDelta = 1,
				windowSeconds = 2.5,
				allowFaster = true,
				minWindows = 3,
			},
			when = "after_claim",
		},
		{
			id = "cubes_collected_gt_0",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "cubes_collected",
			expect = 1,
			when = "end",
		},
		{
			id = "cashin_fx_sent_gt_0",
			kind = "counter_gte",
			counter = "cashin_fx_sent",
			expect = 1,
			when = "end",
		},
		{
			-- Cash leaderstat higher than the value recorded at claim time
			id = "cash_rising",
			kind = "cash_rising",
			counter = "Cash",
			expect = { greaterThan = "claim_time_value" },
			when = "end",
		},
		{
			id = "no_output_errors",
			kind = "no_output_errors",
			counter = "",
			expect = {
				forbidden = { "Error", "Warning" },
				maxAllowed = 0,
			},
			when = "end",
		},
	},
}

return Plan
```

### ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau
```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--   ForgeTelemetry.get("coins_collected")         -- 1 (0 if unset)
--   ForgeTelemetry.snapshot()                     -- copy of all counters
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get()/snapshot() return empty/0.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

local function readAll(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Read-only: a copy of all counters.
function ForgeTelemetry.snapshot(): { [string]: number }
	return readAll()
end

-- get() -> copy of all counters (backward compatible); get(name) -> that counter, 0 if unset.
function ForgeTelemetry.get(name: string?): any
	if name == nil then
		return readAll()
	end
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return 0
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return 0
	end
	local v = f:GetAttribute(key(name))
	if type(v) == "number" then
		return v
	end
	return 0
end

return ForgeTelemetry
```

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.
- Define the data shape that a builder module returns (field names such as origin, gate, spawn) once, and have consumers use those exact fields. Do not add `a or b` fallbacks for guessed names.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.
- When the spec changes the flow (e.g. from auto-assign to claim), rewrite the entry script (Game.server) to require and wire the new modules, and delete the old flow's logic (slots, teleport on join). Updating only the new modules leaves the old behaviour running.
- After a redesign, check that every module is required by the entry script and that its init function is called. Unwired modules never run, and their counters never fire.

```luau
-- ForgeChecks: Studio-only live playtest runner. Reads game state only.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then
	return
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LogService = game:GetService("LogService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Plan = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeChecksPlan", 10))
local Telemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 10))

local PREFIX = "[ForgeCheck]"
local logIssues: { string } = {}

LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message: string, messageType: Enum.MessageType)
	if string.sub(message, 1, #PREFIX) == PREFIX then
		return
	end
	if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then
		table.insert(logIssues, "Error: " .. message)
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then
		table.insert(logIssues, "Warning: " .. message)
	end
end)

local results = {}
local failures = {}
local passed, failed = 0, 0

local function record(id: string, ok: boolean, expected: any, actual: any)
	if ok then
		passed += 1
		Telemetry.count(Plan.telemetry.passed, 1)
		print(`{PREFIX} PASS {id}`)
	else
		failed += 1
		Telemetry.count(Plan.telemetry.failed, 1)
		local e, a = tostring(expected), tostring(actual)
		table.insert(failures, { id = id, expected = e, actual = a })
		print(`{PREFIX} FAIL {id} expected={e} actual={a}`)
	end
end

local function get(name: string): number
	return Telemetry.get(name)
end

local function readCash(player: Player?): number
	if not player then
		return 0
	end
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild(Plan.cashStat.folder)
	local cash = ls and ls:FindFirstChild(Plan.cashStat.name)
	if cash and (cash:IsA("IntValue") or cash:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return cash.Value
	end
	return 0
end

-- pre-claim tracking
local preClaimDropped = 0
local function sample()
	local dropped = get("cubes_dropped")
	if get("plot_assigned") == 0 and dropped > preClaimDropped then
		preClaimDropped = dropped
	end
end

local function waitUntil(cond: () -> boolean, timeout: number): boolean
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < timeout do
		sample()
		if cond() then
			return true
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	sample()
	return cond()
end

local function findGate(): BasePart?
	for _, d in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d.Enabled then
			for _, l in d:GetDescendants() do
				if l:IsA("TextLabel") and string.sub(l.Text, 1, 6) == "Claim " then
					local adornee = d.Adornee
					if adornee and adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
						return adornee
					end
					local p = d.Parent
					if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
						return p
					end
					if p and p:IsA("Model") then
						return p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function run()
	local t0 = os.clock()
	local timing = Plan.timing
	local mode = Workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeCheckMode")
	if mode ~= "gate" and mode ~= "auto" then
		mode = Plan.claimMode
	end

	local player: Player? = nil
	waitUntil(function()
		player = Players:GetPlayers()[1]
		return player ~= nil
	end, 30)

	for _, c in { "map_built", "plaza_built", "themes_built" } do
		waitUntil(function()
			return get(c) >= 1
		end, 20)
	end
	task.wait(timing.settleSeconds)
	local settle = Telemetry.snapshot()

	-- pre-claim window
	local pre = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - pre < timing.preClaimWindow and get("plot_assigned") == 0 do
		sample()
		task.wait(0.25)
	end

	-- claim phase
	local windows = 4
	local deadline = math.max(5, timing.maxRunSeconds - windows * timing.sampleInterval - (os.clock() - t0))
	if mode == "gate" then
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			if get("plot_assigned") >= 1 then
				break
			end
			local gate = findGate()
			local char = player and player.Character
			if gate and char then
				char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(gate.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
			end
			waitUntil(function()
				return get("plot_assigned") >= 1
			end, math.min(4, deadline))
		end
	else
		waitUntil(function()
			return get("plot_assigned") >= 1
		end, deadline)
	end

	local claimCash = readCash(player)
	local maxCash = claimCash
	local prevDropped, prevCollected = get("cubes_dropped"), get("cubes_collected")
	local goodWindows, deltas = 0, {}
	local expectW = Plan.checks[7].expect
	for _ = 1, windows do
		task.wait(timing.sampleInterval)
		local d, c = get("cubes_dropped"), get("cubes_collected")
		local delta = d - prevDropped
		table.insert(deltas, delta)
		if delta >= expectW.minDelta then
			goodWindows += 1
		end
		prevDropped, prevCollected = d, c
		maxCash = math.max(maxCash, readCash(player))
	end
	task.wait(0.5)
	maxCash = math.max(maxCash, readCash(player))

	-- evaluate plan checks
	for _, chk in Plan.checks do
		if chk.onlyMode and chk.onlyMode ~= mode then
			continue
		end
		if chk.kind == "counter_eq" then
			local v = settle[chk.counter] or 0
			record(chk.id, v == chk.expect, chk.expect, v)
		elseif chk.kind == "zero_before_claim" then
			record(chk.id, preClaimDropped == chk.expect, chk.expect, preClaimDropped)
		elseif chk.kind == "counter_gte" then
			local v = get(chk.counter)
			record(chk.id, v >= chk.expect, ">=" .. tostring(chk.expect), v)
		elseif chk.kind == "rising_windows" then
			record(
				chk.id,
				goodWindows >= chk.expect.minWindows,
				`>={chk.expect.minWindows} windows with delta>={chk.expect.minDelta}`,
				`{goodWindows}/{windows} deltas={table.concat(deltas, ",")}`
			)
		elseif chk.kind == "cash_rising" then
			record(chk.id, maxCash > claimCash, "> " .. tostring(claimCash), maxCash)
		elseif chk.kind == "no_output_errors" then
			local n = #logIssues
			local first = logIssues[1] and string.sub(string.gsub(logIssues[1], "%s+", " "), 1, 120) or "none"
			record(chk.id, n <= chk.expect.maxAllowed, chk.expect.maxAllowed, `{n} first={first}`)
		end
	end
	if mode == "gate" then
		local v = get("plots_claimed")
		record("plots_claimed_gte_1", v >= 1, ">=1", v)
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(run)
	if not ok then
		record("runner_error", false, "no error", string.sub(tostring(err), 1, 150))
	end
	print(
		`{PREFIX} RESULT `
			.. HttpService:JSONEncode({ passed = passed, failed = failed, failures = failures })
	)
	Workspace:SetAttribute("ForgeChecksDone", true)
end)
```
